facts.fact: CBE Deputy Governor Rami Aboul Naga said Egypt's financial inclusion rate was 79% at end-June 2026, with about 56.4 million citizens holding active accounts.
CBE Deputy Governor Rami Aboul Naga said the financial inclusion rate was 79% at end-June 2026, up from 77.6% at end-2025 among people aged 15 and over.

note: The 79% is a central bank figure built on active accounts; the document does not name a survey.
